تتعرقبوا (form IIq)
# تَتَعَرْقَبُوا (tataʕarqabū) /ta.ta.ʕar.qa.buː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of تَعَرْقَبَ (taʕarqaba)
# تُتَعَرْقَبُوا (tutaʕarqabū) /tu.ta.ʕar.qa.buː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of تَعَرْقَبَ (taʕarqaba)
